stories.description: Users can now upload multiple documents at once to a claim in Keelwater, streamlining the process and reducing manual effort for claims handlers.
stories.name: Bulk upload documents to a claim

stories.description: Keelwater now allows users to filter claims by date range, status, and claim type, making it easier to locate specific claims without scrolling through unrelated entries.
stories.name: Claim search refinements

stories.description: Keelwater automatically pulls and updates supplier contact details from integrated systems, ensuring claims handlers always have the most current information without manual entry.
stories.name: Supplier contact details

stories.description: Keelwater now provides a clearer, more detailed payment history view, helping users track transactions, refunds, and adjustments with improved timestamps and categorization for faster reconciliation.
stories.name: Payment history improvements

stories.description: Keelwater's workspace administration feature allows users to manage permissions, configure settings, and organize teams within their claims environment — all through a centralized, intuitive dashboard.
stories.name: Workspace administration

stories.description: Keelwater now displays a chronological activity timeline for each claim, showing key events, user actions, and system updates in a clear, scrollable interface to improve case tracking and accountability.
stories.name: Activity timeline display

stories.description: Keelwater's document classifier confidence threshold setting allows users to define the minimum confidence level required for automatic categorization of claims documents, ensuring only high-certainty classifications are applied without manual review.
stories.name: Document classifier confidence threshold

stories.description: Keelwater is enhancing its task list interface to improve user efficiency, allowing for better prioritization, drag-and-drop reordering, and real-time status updates—all designed to streamline claims processing workflows.
stories.name: Task list improvements

stories.description: Keelwater's claim information display provides a clear, real-time overview of active claims, including status, assigned adjuster, and key dates, helping users stay informed without switching screens.
stories.name: Claim information display

stories.description: Keelwater is updating its supplier address fields to support international formats and improve data validation, ensuring accurate claim processing across global regions.
stories.name: Supplier address fields

stories.description: Users can navigate through claim reports using intuitive shortcuts, streamlining access to key data without leaving the current view. Keelwater’s interface ensures quick filtering and drill-downs for efficient claim analysis.
stories.name: Reporting navigation

stories.description: Configure global settings for your organisation within Keelwater, including default claim categories, notification preferences, and user permissions to ensure consistent workflows across teams.
stories.name: Organisation settings
